    - option "Frontend.f_out - httpOut" [selected]

    - option "Database.db_in - dbIn"

    - option "Frontend"
    - option "Frontend.f_out - httpOut"

    - option "Backend.b_in - httpIn"

    - option "Database.db_in - dbIn" [selected]
  - text: Label

  - text: Dashed connector
